versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Skill enables querying token info by keyword, contract address, or chain.
- Provides token search, metadata (name, symbol, links, creator info), real-time market data (price, volume, liquidity, holders), and K-Line candlestick charts.
- Supports BSC, Base, and Solana chains.
- Designed for token discovery, project research, market analysis, and charting.
